title: UI Interaction, Dark Mode by @edo_lunardi: Design engineering tip: don’t forget to respect user preferences. Some
notes:
Design engineering tip: don’t forget to respect user preferences. Some people turn motion off, so give them a simple version. For everyone else, double down on details and connected transitions. For a theme swap, a CSS view transition is the way to go.

Designer: @edo_lunardi. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
